blog.title: Vietnam Travel Guide 2027: Best Places, Trip Costs and Things to Do
blog.content:
Vietnam is becoming one of the most attractive international travel destinations for travelers looking for a combination of natural beauty, cultural experiences, affordable accommodation, delicious food, and exciting adventures. From the lively streets of Hanoi to the beautiful beaches of Da Nang and the historic charm of Hoi An, Vietnam offers unforgettable experiences for every type of traveler.

Whether you are planning a family vacation, honeymoon, solo adventure, or budget-friendly international trip, this Vietnam travel guide 2027 will help you explore the country with confidence.

Vietnam is particularly appealing to Indian travelers because of its relatively affordable travel expenses, varied sightseeing options, and convenient flight connections from major Indian cities.

In this comprehensive guide, we will explore the best places to visit in Vietnam, estimated Vietnam trip cost 2027, local transportation, popular food, visa requirements, and practical travel tips to help you organize a memorable holiday.

Vietnam Travel Guide 2027: Everything You Need to Know Before Visiting

Planning a successful Vietnam travel guide 2027 itinerary starts with understanding the country's geography, weather, transport system, and major tourist destinations.

Located in Southeast Asia, Vietnam is known for its limestone mountains, tropical beaches, ancient temples, traditional markets, and vibrant cities.

The country stretches from the mountainous northern region to the tropical southern coast, offering different landscapes and cultural experiences.

Vietnam can broadly be divided into three travel regions:

  • Northern Vietnam: Famous for Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, and Sapa.

  • Central Vietnam: Popular for Da Nang, Hoi An, Hue, and beautiful coastal attractions.

  • Southern Vietnam: Known for Ho Chi Minh City, the Mekong Delta, and Phu Quoc Island.

Travelers should ideally spend 7 to 14 days exploring Vietnam, depending on the number of destinations they want to cover.

For additional destination information, explore the Official Vietnam Tourism Website.

Best Places to Visit in Vietnam in 2027

Vietnam has numerous tourist attractions ranging from UNESCO World Heritage Sites to modern cities and peaceful natural landscapes.

Here are some of the best places to visit in Vietnam for first-time and returning travelers.

1. Hanoi – Explore Vietnam's Cultural Capital

Hanoi, the capital of Vietnam, is famous for its historic architecture, traditional street markets, local food, and cultural landmarks.

A good Hanoi travel guide should include time to explore the city's Old Quarter, where narrow streets are filled with shops, cafes, restaurants, and historic buildings.

Top attractions in Hanoi:

  • Hoan Kiem Lake: A scenic location for morning walks and photography.

  • Temple of Literature: A historic site reflecting Vietnam's educational heritage.

  • Hanoi Old Quarter: Famous for shopping, street food, and traditional architecture.

  • Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: An important historical landmark.

  • Train Street: A well-known photography location where visitors must respect local safety restrictions.

Visitors should spend approximately 2 to 3 days in Hanoi to explore its major attractions.

2. Ha Long Bay – Experience Beautiful Limestone Islands

Ha Long Bay is one of Vietnam's most recognized natural attractions and a popular destination for boat cruises, kayaking, and sightseeing.

The bay is known for its spectacular limestone formations, emerald-colored water, and scenic islands.

Travelers can enjoy day cruises or overnight cruise experiences depending on their budget.

Popular activities include kayaking, cave exploration, boat sightseeing, and photography.

For travelers interested in natural landscapes, Ha Long Bay is an essential addition to a Vietnam itinerary.

You can learn more about its heritage significance through the UNESCO World Heritage Centre.

3. Da Nang – Beaches, Bridges and Mountain Views

Da Nang is a popular coastal city known for its clean beaches, modern infrastructure, scenic mountains, and exciting tourist attractions.

A complete Da Nang travel guide should include both the city's beaches and its nearby cultural attractions.

Top things to explore in Da Nang:

  • My Khe Beach: A popular destination for relaxation and water activities.

  • Golden Bridge: A famous pedestrian bridge supported by giant sculpted hands at Ba Na Hills.

  • Marble Mountains: A collection of limestone hills with caves and religious sites.

  • Dragon Bridge: A modern landmark known for its distinctive design.

  • Son Tra Peninsula: A scenic area with coastal viewpoints and natural surroundings.

Da Nang is also a convenient base for visiting Hoi An Ancient Town, making it ideal for travelers who want both beach holidays and cultural sightseeing.

4. Hoi An – Discover Traditional Vietnamese Charm

Hoi An is a beautiful historic town famous for its colorful lanterns, preserved architecture, riverside restaurants, and traditional markets.

The town becomes especially attractive in the evening when its streets and riverside areas are illuminated with decorative lanterns.

Visitors can enjoy walking tours, local cooking classes, tailor shops, and traditional Vietnamese food.

Popular experiences include exploring Hoi An Ancient Town, visiting the Japanese Covered Bridge, and enjoying a boat ride along the Thu Bon River.

Hoi An is a wonderful destination for couples, families, photographers, and cultural travelers.

5. Ho Chi Minh City – Modern Life and Historical Attractions

Formerly known as Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City is Vietnam's largest city and an important commercial and cultural center.

Some of the most popular Ho Chi Minh City attractions include:

  • War Remnants Museum: An important museum exploring Vietnam's wartime history.

  • Ben Thanh Market: A popular shopping destination for souvenirs and local products.

  • Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon: A historic architectural landmark, with restoration work affecting access.

  • Cu Chi Tunnels: A historical tunnel network located outside the city.

  • Nguyen Hue Walking Street: A lively pedestrian area surrounded by modern buildings.

Travelers should consider spending 2 to 3 days exploring the city and nearby attractions.

6. Phu Quoc Island – A Tropical Beach Destination

Phu Quoc Island is an excellent destination for travelers interested in beach resorts, island experiences, water activities, and peaceful holidays.

The island offers beautiful coastlines, seafood restaurants, sunset viewpoints, and luxury accommodation.

Popular experiences include snorkeling, island-hopping tours, beach relaxation, and cable car rides.

Phu Quoc is especially suitable for honeymoon couples and travelers seeking a relaxing beach vacation.

Best Time to Visit Vietnam in 2027

Choosing the best time to visit Vietnam depends on which part of the country you plan to explore.

Because Vietnam stretches across several climate zones, weather conditions vary significantly between the north, central, and southern regions.

Region Recommended Travel Months Weather Highlights
Northern Vietnam October to April Cooler temperatures and generally comfortable sightseeing conditions
Central Vietnam February to May Often suitable for beaches and outdoor activities
Southern Vietnam November to April Generally drier and warmer conditions
Phu Quoc Island December to March Often favorable for beach activities

For travelers visiting several regions, March and April can offer a useful balance of weather conditions.

However, Vietnam experiences seasonal rainfall, tropical storms, and regional weather variations, so travelers should check forecasts before booking outdoor activities.

The Lonely Planet guide to the best time to visit Vietnam provides additional seasonal travel information.

Vietnam Trip Cost 2027: Estimated Travel Budget

One of the biggest reasons travelers choose Vietnam is its affordable travel cost compared with many other international destinations.

However, the actual Vietnam trip cost 2027 will depend on travel dates, flight prices, hotel categories, transportation choices, and sightseeing activities.

The following estimates provide a practical planning range for Indian travelers.

Estimated Vietnam Travel Budget from India

Travel Expenses Estimated Cost Per Person
Round-trip flights from India ₹18,000 – ₹35,000
Accommodation for 7 nights ₹7,000 – ₹18,000
Food and beverages ₹4,000 – ₹8,000
Local transportation ₹3,000 – ₹7,000
Sightseeing and activities ₹5,000 – ₹12,000
Visa and travel insurance ₹3,000 – ₹5,000
Estimated total ₹40,000 – ₹85,000

These are illustrative planning estimates for 2027, not confirmed future prices. They assume a relatively economical trip, with accommodation costs calculated on a per-person basis.

Travelers choosing luxury resorts, premium cruises, private transfers, and high-end dining may spend considerably more.

Flight prices may also increase during festivals, holidays, and peak tourist seasons.

For accurate budgeting, compare current flight prices, hotel rates, and activity costs before making reservations.

Vietnam Itinerary 7 Days: A Practical Travel Plan

A well-organized Vietnam itinerary 7 days can help first-time visitors experience several popular destinations without spending too much time planning.

For a week-long holiday, a Northern and Central Vietnam itinerary is a practical choice.

Day Destination Recommended Activities
Day 1 Hanoi Arrival, Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake
Day 2 Hanoi Temple of Literature, museums, street food
Day 3 Ha Long Bay Day cruise, sightseeing, kayaking
Day 4 Da Nang Travel to Da Nang, My Khe Beach
Day 5 Da Nang Ba Na Hills, Golden Bridge
Day 6 Hoi An Ancient Town, lantern markets, local food
Day 7 Da Nang Shopping and departure

This itinerary offers a combination of history, beaches, natural scenery, cultural experiences, and local cuisine.

Travelers interested in Ho Chi Minh City can replace the northern or central portion of the itinerary with a southern Vietnam experience.

Trying to visit every major destination in just seven days may lead to unnecessary travel expenses and exhaustion.

Vietnam Visa Requirements for Indians in 2027

Understanding the Vietnam visa requirements for Indians is essential before planning an international holiday.

As of October 2026, Indian passport holders generally need a valid visa before entering Vietnam.

Vietnam offers an electronic visa (e-Visa) system that allows eligible travelers to apply online.

Under the current rules, an e-Visa may be issued for up to 90 days, with single-entry or multiple-entry options.

Documents Commonly Required

  • Valid Indian passport, meeting the applicable validity requirements

  • Recent passport photograph in the required format

  • Passport information page

  • Travel details and intended entry information

  • Valid payment method for the visa application fee

Travelers should apply through the official Vietnam Immigration e-Visa Portal.

The Embassy of India in Hanoi also provides important information for Indian travelers visiting Vietnam.

Important: Visa rules, fees, processing times, and entry conditions may change before 2027. Always verify the latest official requirements before booking non-refundable travel arrangements.

Best Things to Do in Vietnam for Tourists

Vietnam offers activities for almost every travel style, from adventure tourism to cultural sightseeing.

Here are some popular things to do in Vietnam during your holiday.

Experience a Ha Long Bay Cruise

A Ha Long Bay cruise offers beautiful views of limestone islands and coastal landscapes. Travelers can choose between day trips and overnight cruise packages.

Explore Vietnamese Street Food

Vietnam is famous for its street food culture, where travelers can try traditional dishes at local restaurants and markets.

Visit Traditional Markets

Popular markets in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Hoi An offer opportunities to purchase souvenirs, clothing, handicrafts, and local products.

Discover Vietnam's Historical Landmarks

Explore ancient temples, museums, heritage buildings, and historical sites to understand the country's cultural background.

Relax on Beautiful Beaches

Vietnam's coastline offers several beach destinations, including Da Nang, Nha Trang, and Phu Quoc.

Enjoy Nature and Adventure

Travelers interested in outdoor experiences can explore Sapa's mountain landscapes, Ninh Binh's waterways, and Phong Nha's cave systems.

Famous Vietnamese Food You Should Try

Food is an important part of the Vietnam travel experience.

Vietnamese cuisine is known for its fresh herbs, rice noodles, vegetables, aromatic broths, and balanced flavors.

Some popular dishes include:

Vietnamese Food Description
Pho Traditional Vietnamese noodle soup
Banh Mi Vietnamese baguette sandwich with different fillings
Bun Cha Grilled pork served with noodles and herbs
Goi Cuon Fresh Vietnamese spring rolls
Banh Xeo Crispy Vietnamese savory pancake
Com Tam Broken rice dish commonly served with grilled meat
Vietnamese Coffee Strong coffee often served with condensed milk

Vegetarian travelers can also find suitable meals in major tourist destinations.

When ordering food, it is useful to confirm ingredients because some dishes may contain fish sauce, meat broth, or seafood-based seasonings.

Transportation Options in Vietnam

Understanding local transportation is important for controlling Vietnam travel expenses.

Vietnam offers several transportation options for both short-distance and long-distance travel.

Domestic Flights

Domestic flights are useful for traveling between major cities such as Hanoi, Da Nang, and Ho Chi Minh City.

Flying can save time when covering long distances.

Trains

Vietnam's railway network connects many major destinations and offers travelers an opportunity to experience scenic landscapes and countryside views.

Buses

Intercity buses and sleeper buses are popular among budget travelers.

They can be economical, although travel times may be longer than flights.

Taxis and Ride-Hailing Services

Travelers can use established taxi companies and available ride-hailing apps for convenient local transportation.

Walking and Organized Tours

Walking tours are ideal for exploring historic districts, while organized day tours can be useful for destinations located outside major cities.

Vietnam Holiday Packages vs Independent Travel

Many tourists compare Vietnam holiday packages with independent travel before making their bookings.

Both options offer advantages depending on budget, convenience, travel experience, and personal preferences.

Vietnam holiday packages may include hotels, airport transfers, sightseeing tours, and selected meals.

These packages can be convenient for families, first-time international travelers, and group vacations.

Independent travel provides greater flexibility to choose accommodation, transportation, restaurants, and sightseeing activities.

Budget travelers may prefer booking flights and hotels separately, while travelers seeking convenience may benefit from organized packages.

Before purchasing any holiday package, check the inclusions, exclusions, cancellation policy, hotel location, and additional activity charges.

Essential Vietnam Travel Tips for First-Time Visitors

Following practical Vietnam travel tips can make your international holiday safer and more enjoyable.

1. Carry Vietnamese Dong

The official currency is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). Carrying some local currency is useful for street food, small shops, and local markets.

2. Purchase Travel Insurance

Travel insurance can help provide financial protection against certain unexpected medical expenses, travel disruptions, and baggage-related problems, depending on policy coverage.

3. Book Flights in Advance

Booking flights early may help travelers find more suitable schedules and fares, particularly during peak travel seasons.

4. Respect Local Culture

When visiting temples, religious sites, and traditional communities, dress appropriately and follow local customs.

5. Use Reliable Transportation

Choose reputable taxi services, established ride-hailing platforms, and licensed tour operators whenever possible.

6. Stay Connected

Consider purchasing a local SIM card or compatible eSIM for navigation, communication, and travel bookings.

7. Protect Important Documents

Keep digital and physical copies of your passport, visa, insurance details, and hotel reservations.

8. Check Weather Conditions

Weather conditions can vary significantly between regions, especially during the rainy and tropical storm seasons.

9. Avoid Overcrowded Itineraries

Leave enough time for transportation, sightseeing, relaxation, and unexpected delays.

10. Verify Entry Requirements

Always confirm the latest visa rules, passport validity requirements, and immigration procedures before departure.

Conclusion

Vietnam is an excellent destination for travelers who want to experience beautiful landscapes, fascinating culture, historic attractions, delicious food, and affordable international travel.

Whether you want to explore the lively streets of Hanoi, enjoy a cruise through Ha Long Bay, relax on the beaches of Da Nang, or discover the vibrant atmosphere of Ho Chi Minh City, the country offers memorable experiences for different travel interests.

This Vietnam travel guide 2027 provides the essential information needed to plan your trip, including popular tourist destinations, estimated travel costs, visa requirements, transportation options, and practical travel advice.

Before finalizing your journey, compare flight prices, hotel options, travel packages, and sightseeing costs to build an itinerary that matches your budget.

With proper planning, Vietnam can offer an enjoyable combination of adventure, relaxation, cultural discovery, and value for money.

Travel Note: All costs mentioned are estimated planning ranges for 2027. Actual prices, visa policies, transportation availability, and attraction schedules may change. Verify current information with official authorities and travel providers before booking.

faqs.question: Is Vietnam expensive for Indian tourists?
faqs.answer: Vietnam can be a budget-friendly international destination for Indian travelers. A seven-day holiday may cost approximately ₹40,000 to ₹85,000 per person, depending on flights, accommodation, activities, and travel preferences.

faqs.question: How many days are enough for Vietnam?
faqs.answer: A 7-day Vietnam trip is suitable for exploring selected destinations, while 10 to 14 days allows travelers to experience more regions at a comfortable pace.

faqs.question: Which month is best for visiting Vietnam?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Vietnam depends on the region. March and April are often useful months for multi-region travel, while northern, central, and southern Vietnam have different seasonal conditions.

faqs.question: Do Indians need a visa for Vietnam?
faqs.answer: Under the rules applicable as of October 2026, Indian passport holders generally require a visa. Eligible travelers can apply through Vietnam's official e-Visa portal. Requirements should be checked again before traveling in 2027.

faqs.question: What are the most popular tourist destinations in Vietnam?
faqs.answer: Some of the most popular destinations include Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Ninh Binh, Sapa, and Phu Quoc Island.

faqs.question: Is Vietnam suitable for a honeymoon?
faqs.answer: Yes, Vietnam offers several attractive honeymoon destinations, including Phu Quoc, Da Nang, Hoi An, and Ha Long Bay, with options ranging from affordable hotels to luxury resorts.

faqs.question: Can I travel to Vietnam on a limited budget?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choosing budget accommodation, local restaurants, public transportation, and carefully planned sightseeing activities can help reduce overall travel expenses.
